cards.answer: Diana is an AP fighter and assassin who deals magic damage. She marks enemies with Moonlight to enable repeated dashes, then fights up close with empowered attacks and an area pull followed by delayed damage.
cards.counterplay: Dodge her arcing projectile, respect her engage while marked, and spread out when she approaches.

cards.counterplay: Sidestep the arc and its endpoint; give her space while marked.

cards.answer: Pale Cascade shields Diana and creates orbiting spheres that explode on enemy contact, dealing area magic damage. If all the spheres detonate, she gains additional shielding and refreshes its duration.
cards.counterplay: Create distance while her spheres orbit, and avoid committing damage into her shield.

cards.answer: Lunar Rush dashes to an enemy and deals magic damage, consuming Moonlight from all enemies when the dash ends. Consuming Moonlight from her target greatly reduces the dash's cooldown, allowing her to dash again shortly afterward.
cards.counterplay: Respect her follow-up dash after a marked engage; look for opportunities after she dashes to an unmarked target.

cards.counterplay: Spread out as she engages, and move away from her before the delayed damage lands.
